audit.title: Data Feeds on Solana

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Sections open reasonably ("Price Feeds are available on the following Solana clusters"). Weak spot: the page never leads with a liftable summary of the two supported clusters plus the Testnet exclusion — the single most-queried fact.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Clean H1→H2, 0 level skips, 4 well-sized sections (median 168 words). No tables — a cluster-support matrix would be a natural, high-extract unit.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: Prose carries just 1 numeral (0 with units); the substance (`solana-cli 1.9.28`, cluster versions) lives only in code fences. No feed count, heartbeat, deviation threshold, or decimals. Vague quantifier "several" present.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: Strong; no action needed. 30 links, 5 to primary sources (github, rust-lang), each claim attributable.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: Good candidates ("In Solana, storage and smart contract logic are separate"; account+program ≈ EVM smart contract), but the concept is restated redundantly rather than crisply pinned once.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: Weak. Measured facts show 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no datePublished/dateModified, 0 OG/Twitter tags. (Head not captured by the harness — CLI should pass raw `<head>`; but the JSON-LD absence is confirmed from served HTML.)

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: Two tagged `shell` blocks, both substantive, with realistic output shown. Gap: no runnable Rust/JS snippet actually *reading* a feed, despite the page naming the toolchain.

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Covers setup → tools → wallets, but no debug/troubleshooting, no "how do I read a price feed on Solana," no error-string coverage. Half the lifecycle is absent.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Unambiguous, consistent product naming. Minor redundancy ("State and logic are separate" said twice).

audit.summary: This is a clean, well-linked environment-setup page for Chainlink Data Feeds on Solana, covering the account/program model, supported clusters, toolchain, and wallets. Its strongest GEO asset is dense authoritative linking (23 external links, 5 to primary sources); its biggest opportunities are missing machine-readable metadata (no JSON-LD, canonical, or last-updated signal) and thin symptom/query coverage — there is no troubleshooting section and no answer-first statement of the highest-value facts (which clusters are supported, that Testnet is *not*). The pinned Solana CLI version (`1.9.28`) is now years stale and, with no visible `dateModified`, this undermines the freshness signals engines reward.

recommendations.title: Add machine-readable metadata
recommendations.issue: 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no dateModified.
recommendations.change: Emit `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `headline`, `dateModified`, `inLanguage`, and a self-referential canonical URL; surface a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: Freshness and E-E-A-T signals raise trust and citation rate; canonical prevents dilution across cluster/network variants.

recommendations.title: Add answer-first cluster summary + Testnet exclusion as a lead
recommendations.where: top of "Chainlink products and Solana clusters"
recommendations.issue: support facts are diffuse; Testnet exclusion buried mid-paragraph.
recommendations.change: Open with one liftable sentence + a small table: "Chainlink Data Feeds are live on Solana Mainnet and Devnet. They are **not** available on Solana Testnet." Columns: Cluster | Feeds available | Notes.
recommendations.why: A self-contained table/statement is the unit engines lift verbatim and defends against a skimmed page answering "yes" for Testnet.

recommendations.title: Add a symptom/troubleshooting section
recommendations.issue: no debug content; devs query by error string.
recommendations.change: Add "Troubleshooting" with headings phrased as questions/errors, e.g. "Why is my `anchor deploy` failing on Devnet?", "CLI version mismatch with cluster", "Insufficient SOL / airdrop failed."
recommendations.why: Symptom-titled headings win retrieval that concept prose loses, even when the fix is otherwise inferable.

recommendations.title: Replace stale pinned version with a version-agnostic rule + refresh
recommendations.issue: `1.9.28` is years old; no date makes it read as abandoned.
recommendations.change: Keep the `solana --version`/`cluster-version` commands, but caption that output is illustrative and refresh to a current release; state the actual rule ("CLI ≥ target cluster version") in prose above the fence.
recommendations.why: Stale version strings trigger low-trust/deprecation inferences; the durable rule outlives any single release.

recommendations.title: Add concrete feed specifics
recommendations.change: State the number of live Solana feeds, typical decimals, and heartbeat/deviation behavior (or link the addresses page with those columns). Replace "several developer tools" with the specific Anchor tools.
recommendations.why: Quantitative claims are among the highest-lift changes for citation.

recommendations.title: Name the canonical Solana read pattern; flag the EVM one as wrong
recommendations.issue: page describes tooling but never states how a feed is actually read on Solana.
recommendations.change: Add one liftable sentence: "On Solana, read Data Feeds via the Chainlink Solana store program / Starter Kit — the EVM `AggregatorV3Interface` (Solidity) does **not** apply." Link the Starter Kit.
recommendations.why: Without retrieval, models default to the generic EVM idiom; naming the wrong pattern as a Don't blocks that override.

recommendations.title: Add a minimal runnable feed-read snippet
recommendations.where: end of toolchain or new "Read a feed" section
recommendations.issue: no Rust/JS example despite naming both.
recommendations.change: Add a short, complete Anchor/Rust or JS snippet (imports + program/account IDs + expected output) reading a Devnet feed.
recommendations.why: Complete, copy-pasteable code with output is what coding agents lift to complete tasks.

antiPatterns: **Stale/undated content:** pinned `solana-cli 1.9.28` with no `dateModified` — reads as abandoned.
**Vague quantifier:** "several developer tools" — replace with specifics.
**Minor redundancy:** "State and logic are separate in Solana" restates the prior sentence.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is already referenced at the top — good; confirm this page is indexed there.
Site-level: canonical URLs and `TechArticle` schema appear absent site-wide from the served HTML; a template-level fix would lift many sibling pages at once.
Freshness cadence: establish a review/last-updated stamp so version-pinned pages don't silently rot.
